detail:
fnn-bpnc-execute (bp-control.lisp:84-104) runs fnn-quantum-bp (O) around fnn-owner-live-reconfigure-locked and then, inside the same thunk (the cond arm at bp-control.lisp:~104 is lexically in the lambda), fnn-bplc-reconfigure (bp-listener-control.lisp:95) -> fnn-bplc-drive (bp-listener-control.lisp:~36-80): fnn-tcl-listen bind, socket-close (line 70, retire), and fnn-out 'BP NODE LISTENING' (line 48), 'runtime line' (line 78); fnn-out -> fnn-emit (io.lisp:998-999) = write-sequence then finish-output on *fnn-stdout* (a blocking fd-stream, :buffering :full, io.lisp:~988).
Keys: R2|fnn-emit|O:write-sequence, R2|fnn-emit|O:finish-output (checker counts 13 sites under O; only this one traced; others not enumerated by the checker's output and not individually verified). Same chain also reaches bplc-cut's finish-output/sleep (developer selector FN_BP_LISTENER_TEST_PAUSE_CUT only; test-only pause loop) and socket-close (bp-listener-control.lisp:70), which are baselined/unlisted.
Hazard: a blocked stdout pipe (supervisor not draining) stalls the owner mutex.
fix: Emit the BP NODE lines after the section returns (return the lines as data), and do the listener drive outside the owner section or justify it as a design decision; fnn-out under O is the baseline hazard of every site in the 13.
notes: 10-06 20:24 NOT FIXED, kept open (lane lock-host-fix-2); needs a DESIGN. (1) The key R2|fnn-emit|O:write-sequence/finish-output is reached from 13 sites under O (checker weight 13); moving this site only makes it 12, the key stays. (2) Moving fnn-bplc-reconfigure out of fnn-quantum-bp changes fencing: in the section a bind/retire/emit failure is classified by the envelope (fnn-owner-shared-action-locked, fn-fs-classify with the last durable step, fence before the mutex is released); outside it would have to go through fnn-owner-thread-escape, which classifies with a stale *fnn-section-step*, so an envelope-classified failure becomes a thread-escape with possibly different class. Needed: a design for an I/O-after-section escape that fences equivalently (the section returns the drive as data, and the post-section escape carries the durable-step context), plus a decision on the other 12 fnn-emit sites. Image-only natives (FN_BP_LISTENER_TEST_PAUSE_CUT) would gate it.

10-06 20:39 DESIGN written: docs/design/listener-reconfig-off-lock.md (lane listener-design): drive after release, failure re-signalled in a settle fnn-quantum-bp so the envelope classifies; lines returned only for contended sections; 11 private-owner command sites declared as exceptions.

Gone: R2 fnn-bplc-cut O:finish-output/O:sleep, fnn-bplc-drive O:socket-close, fnn-listen O:{socket-bind,socket-listen,socket-name,sockopt-reuse-address}, fnn-socket-shut O:socket-close. fnn-emit O:write-sequence/finish-output weight 13 -> 11, the key stays: the remaining 11 sites are the one-shot bp-obligation commands, owned by LOCK-R2-OFFLINE-ONESHOT-HOLD. NATIVES OWED (image, convergence): tests/test_bp_node_native.py test_live_listener_rebind_keeps_old_session_generation_and_fd, test_live_listener_occupied_port_is_uncertain_and_restart_reconciles, test_death_at_each_live_listener_effect_recovers_published_configuration (FN_BP_LISTENER_TEST_PAUSE_CUT), test_control_listener_retires_after_one_normal_bp_session; plus a new image case: a status request answers during a PAUSE_CUT pause. Open risk: no stopping check in the drive loop.
scenario: BP configuration change through the BP control socket: stdout lines are emitted while O is held; a full stdout pipe blocks the owner.
